questions.text: Should the dashboard lead with margin percentage per project, or with the euro margin per project?
questions.hint: Determines the main KPI on the PoC.

questions.text: Should each project's margin be shown against the fixed 15% threshold, or against the project's own budget?
questions.hint: Decides the reference line in the dashboard.

questions.text: Should the margin be broken down per project only, or also per cost type like hours versus materials?
questions.hint: Shapes the drill-down in the PoC.

questions.text: Is the Bergen op Zoom project's margin figure known well enough to use as a sample case?
questions.hint: A real example makes the PoC land.

questions.text: Should projects below 15% be flagged as a red row, or as a separate alert list at the top?
questions.hint: Affects how Lisa spots problems at a glance.
